أستوئي (form X)
# أَسْتَوْئِي (ʔastawʔī) /ʔas.taw.ʔiː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَوْأَى (istawʔā) and اِسْتَوْءَى (istawʔā)
# أَسْتَوْئِيَ (ʔastawʔiya) /ʔas.taw.ʔi.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَوْأَى (istawʔā) and اِسْتَوْءَى (istawʔā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
